Wikipedia: Omar Haji Mohamed (led the SNF from 1991)

parties.popularity_note: No vote has ever been held; gameplay estimate. In 1999 several Mogadishu sharia courts were already cooperating; the Islamic Courts Council was formed during 2000.

source.title: Wikipedia: Islamic Courts Union (courts united in 1999-2000; Sharif Sheikh Ahmed chairman from 2004; Shura council under Hassan Dahir Aweys from 26 June 2006; toppled December 2006; succeeded by the ARS in 2007)

parties.review_note: The Wikipedia infobox gives foundation 2000 and dissolution '2007-2009', and the text says eleven courts formed the Islamic Courts Council 'during 2000'. Status 'active' on 1 January 2000 reflects the courts' cooperation from April 1999; confirm the founding date and whether the ICU should instead appear as not yet founded.

name.en: Alliance for the Re-liberation of Somalia

parties.popularity_note: Founded in Eritrea in September 2007 as the political successor to the ICU; its Djibouti wing joined the transitional parliament in 2008-2009.

source.title: Wikipedia: Alliance for the Re-liberation of Somalia (founded September 2007; chair Sharif Sheikh Ahmed; split into Djibouti and Asmara wings in 2008)

parties.popularity_note: Armed Salafi jihadist movement, active from August 2006; it emerged from the ICU's military wing and has fought the transitional and federal governments since. Its first emir, Ismail Arale (2006-2007), is omitted because no Wikipedia or Wikidata record for him was found.

source.title: Wikipedia: Al-Shabaab (militant group) (active from August 2006; emirs Ismail Arale 2006-2007, Ahmed Godane 2007-2014, Ahmad Diriye since 2014)
Wikidata: Ahmed Abdi Godane (leader of al-Shabaab 2007-2014)

parties.popularity_note: Founded in April 2011 by Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, who won the 2012 indirect presidential election as its candidate.

source.title: Wikipedia: Peace and Development Party (founded April 2011 by Hassan Sheikh Mohamud; succeeded by the UPD on 4 October 2018)

name.en: Union for Peace and Development Party

parties.popularity_note: Unveiled on 4 October 2018, formed by the Peace and Development Party and the Horseed caucus. Its leader Hassan Sheikh Mohamud won the 2022 indirect presidential election and Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre is a member.

source.title: Wikipedia: Union for Peace and Development Party (founded 4 October 2018; leader Hassan Sheikh Mohamud; green and white)

parties.popularity_note: Founded in 2012 by Mohamed Abdullahi Mohamed (Farmaajo), who won the 2017 indirect presidential election as its candidate. Described by Wikipedia as a liberal party; light blue.
